en.headline: Man stabbed in Kwun Tong collapses and is rushed to hospital
en.dek: Police received a report around 1:17 am of a knife attack on Fuk Yan Street near Tung Yan Street; the victim regained consciousness after treatment.
body: Police received a report at about 1:17 am on Friday that a man had been attacked with a knife on Fuk Yan Street near Tung Yan Street in Kwun Tong. Officers found the man with a bleeding wound to his left forearm; he then collapsed and was taken by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital, where he regained consciousness after treatment.

Investigators located the scene outside 8 Fuk Yan Street, where bloodstains were found on a staircase. A blood-stained coat and a trail of blood were also discovered nearby, including along a lane leading towards Nga Mei Road and at a gate on Fuk Yan Street. A passer-by who saw the injured man alerted police.
Police are reviewing closed-circuit television footage from the area. The suspect remains at large and the motive is under investigation. The case has been classified as wounding.

zh.headline: 觀塘男子被斬傷昏迷送院 經搶救後清醒
zh.dek: 警方凌晨1時17分左右接獲福仁街近同仁街傷人報案，傷者左前臂受傷流血後昏迷，送伊利沙伯醫院後回復清醒，凶徒在逃。
body: 警方今日凌晨1時17分左右接獲報案，指觀塘福仁街近同仁街有人持刀襲擊一名男子。警員趕抵現場時發現傷者左前臂受傷流血，隨即昏迷，由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院，經搶救後回復清醒。
調查人員發現涉事地點位於福仁街8號大廈對開，樓梯位置留有血跡。通往雅美道的巷子附近亦發現一件染血外套及大量血跡，福仁街閘口留下血路。途人發現異常後報警。
警方正翻查現場附近閉路電視搜證，凶徒仍然在逃，行凶動機仍在調查中。案件列作傷人案處理。
